description: Source code implementing Bluetooth Encrypted Advertisement Data (EAD) encryption and decryption functions for Nordic Semiconductor's Zephyr OS, including randomizer and nonce generation, encryption, decryption, and testing functions.

methods.name: bt_ead_generate_randomizer
methods.description: Generates a randomizer value used in the EAD encryption process.

methods.name: bt_ead_generate_nonce
methods.description: Generates a nonce combining the randomizer and IV for encryption.

methods.name: ead_encrypt
methods.description: Performs the core encryption of payload data using CCM mode.

methods.name: bt_ead_encrypt
methods.description: Public API for encrypting payload data with session key and IV.

methods.name: bt_test_ead_encrypt
methods.description: Test version of the encryption function, includes explicit randomizer parameter.

methods.name: ead_decrypt
methods.description: Performs the core decryption of encrypted payload data.

methods.name: bt_ead_decrypt
methods.description: Public API for decrypting encrypted payload data with session key and IV.
